title: Pause Regions
description: Minecraft plugin that turns on/off block update in region you want
body:
# PauseRegions - Control Block Updates in Protected Areas

PauseRegions is a powerful Paper plugin that allows server administrators to create special regions where block updates are paused while still allowing players to build freely. Perfect for protecting complex builds from natural decay, fluid flow, and other environmental changes without restricting player creativity.

Key Features:
-     🗺️ Region Creation: Define cuboid regions with /pr pos1 and /pr pos2 commands
-     ⏯️ Toggle Physics: Enable/disable block updates per region with /pr toggle <name>
-     💾 Persistent Storage: Regions save automatically and persist through server restarts
-     🚫 Blocks Natural Processes: Stops:
- - Block physics (sand/gravel falling)
- - Plant growth (crops, trees)
- - Leaf decay
- - Fluid flow (water/lava)
- - Block spreading (grass, mycelium)
- - Ice formation
-     📋 Region Management: List all regions with /pr list


Commands:
- /pr pos1 - Set first position
- /pr pos2 - Set second position
- /pr create <name> - Create new region
- /pr toggle <name> - Toggle block updates
- /pr list - Show all regions

Permissions:

    pauseregions.command - Access to all commands (default: op)

Compatibility: Paper 1.21.4

Installation:

1.     Download the latest JAR
1.     Place in your plugins folder
1.     Restart server

Perfect for creative builds, museum areas, or any location where you want to preserve the exact state of blocks while still allowing player interaction!
